component.name: li-monitoring
component.summary: Battery health analysis and optimization tool

description.p: li-monitoring analyzes battery health and helps you extend battery lifetime. It shows design vs. full capacity, charge cycles, temperature, voltage, current and power draw in real time, and keeps a charge history graph.
On Lenovo laptops, the native (non-sandboxed) install can enable the battery conservation mode with a single click (charge stops around 60-80%), and the app includes a step-by-step calibration guide.
Available in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français and Español.
XDG-compliant data paths (config and history persist in the Flatpak sandbox) and updated GNOME runtime.
Flatpak packaging support (Flatpak-spawn host integration for conservation mode).
Redesigned details section: metric grid, colored values and health/charge progress bars.
Modern dark design refresh: cards, gradients, donut health ring, filled chart.
